name: codex_cli
description: Read-only Codex CLI integration for repository explanation and review.

tools.name: codex_explain
tools.description: Ask Codex CLI to explain a repository area without writing files.

tools.name: codex_review
tools.description: Ask Codex CLI to review a file or diff without writing files.

tools.name: codex_patch
tools.description: Ask Codex CLI to generate and apply a patch. Requires explicit user approval.

tools.name: codex_fix_tests
tools.description: Ask Codex CLI to fix failing tests. Requires explicit user approval.
